headline: Ibovespa Falls for Fourth Session as Brazilian Real Weakens to 5.39
summary: Brazil's benchmark stock index dropped 1.16% to 169,029 on October 29, extending its post-election retreat to 17.5% over four sessions. Concurrently, the Brazilian real depreciated to 5.39 per US dollar.
why: Brazil is Latin America's largest economy; investor sentiment is heavily influenced by fiscal trajectory concerns and global commodity price fluctuations.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Broad risk aversion and currency depreciation prompted foreign and domestic institutional exits.
